blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A 69-year-old South Korean missionary and a 49-year-old pastor drowned in the Ikmin River in Sitio Bani, Poblacion, Boliney, Abra on Friday, Sept. 25. The victims were identified as Hye Sook Byeon, 69, a missionary from South Korea, and Pastor Zosimo Gaano, 49, of Jesus Our Banner Church. According to the municipal government, Byeon was swept away by the river’s strong current. Gaano attempted to rescue the elderly female missionary but he was also carried away by the rushing water.
